AK74_Desc: The Kalashnikov assault rifle, folding-stock model of 1974, chambered for the 5.45x39 mm cartridge. A simple and reliable weapon, though its low production cost somewhat affected handling comfort and shooting accuracy. In the Zone, it is the primary weapon of military stalkers and many loners.
PM_Desc: The most common pistol in the Zone, a legacy of the Soviet era. Quite reliable and inexpensive, but has a low magazine capacity, insufficient stopping power, and poor round accuracy. The standard weapon of rookie stalkers.
Ammo9x18_Desc: Standard ammunition for the PM pistol. Simple core, full metal jacket bullet. Weak armor-piercing capability.
Ammo5x45_Desc: Standard ammunition for the AK-74 assault rifle. Simple core, full metal jacket bullet.
